fmax_mhz.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

gatemate_bitstream_flashed.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal prefix or blocked prefix records whether GateMate can graduate from mandatory to opportunistic hardware continuity.

inference_substrate.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

lut_dff_utilization.principle: Real synthesis/P&R numbers anchor the n=16 tile to actual GateMate resources instead of a paper estimate.

lut_used.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

no_tautology.principle: BARE BOOL -- total wall-clock and board-run timers are distinct.

preconditions_checked.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

readback_supported.principle: Honest record of whether this flow supports readback at all.

readback_verified.principle: BARE BOOL -- did a JTAG readback confirm the flashed tile matches the bitstream.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Hardware-smoke methodology -- real board interaction; terminal-state evidence.

run_duration_s.principle: On-board run time only -- distinct timer.

sample_timing_basis.principle: Explains the timing basis so a routed clock estimate is not confused with a host-visible sampler transcript.

sample_timing_note.principle: Explains why sample_timing_us is null when the board can be flashed but the programmed design has no supported host-visible timing path.

sample_timing_us.principle: Sample-level one-clock spin-update timing derived from routed Fmax; this is not host readback latency.

smoke_ok.principle: BARE BOOL -- the flash/contact smoke stage completed with board-visible success evidence.

synth_pnr_pack_succeeded.principle: Bare bool -- the toolchain end-to-end produced a bitstream, separable from the flash step.

terminal_state_reached.principle: BARE BOOL -- flashed + smoke + readback-or-unsupported + no-tautology; the graduation signal.

thermal_note.principle: GateMate is passively cooled, so the artifact must disclose that burst smoke results are not sustained-load thermal evidence.
